<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The Emperor's little sister was tall and strikingly beautiful, with smooth skin and a delicate face that had “inspired” any number of ambitious painters in the Empire.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|— ''Skysworn'', chapter 11}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Naru Saeya Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Naru]] Saeya, also known as Saeya, is the younger sister of [[Naru Huan]], the Emperor of the [[Blackflame Empire]]. She is a tall and strikingly beautiful woman who possesses emerald wings associated with the [[Path of Grasping Sky]]. These wings are noted for being smaller and sleeker than typical for her [[Path]], granting her superior speed. She is a skilled combatant with highly developed senses and an impressive attunement to [[Wind aura|wind aura]], allowing her to detect movement in the air from great distances. In battle, she utilizes a [[sword]] made of shimmering, rainbow-colored light drawn from her [[soulspace]] and can employ [[green madra]] to restrain opponents. Saeya has distinguished herself as a formidable warrior, notably fighting against two [[Underlord|Underlords]] simultaneously during conflicts involving the [[Seishen Empire]]. Her combat prowess and dedication to her empire have earned her significant recognition, including praise from the Emperor himself. Beyond her martial abilities, she is characterized by a determined and sometimes fierce temperament, though she has also shown the capacity to be friendly. She is a member of the [[Naru clan]] and operates within the hierarchy of the [[Blackflame Empire]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Naru]] Saeya possesses emerald wings that serve as the [[Goldsign]] of her [[Path]]. She is seen wearing peacock feathers behind one ear.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|As the [[Emperor's sister]], she leads the march for the [[Blackflame Empire]] team. She has previously trained other [[Underlord|Underlords]] from her Empire and has offered observations regarding the Emperor's feelings toward [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Naru]] Saeya is the sister of the Emperor. She was a former team member of [[Lindon]] and has discussed the battles of [[Yerin]]. Additionally, she noted that the Emperor felt pleasure regarding both [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|She utilizes [[green wind madra]] and a [[Wind aura|wind aura]] to perform tasks such as floating large objects or sweeping away attacks. Her skills include the use of [[Ruler techniques]], and she wields a [[rainbow sword]].}}
